description: Simulate built steps on a fork (Tenderly) from the owner's address before anyone signs. Pass `steps` and `expiresAt` exactly as a build_* tool returned them. Check `ok`; on failure the failing step carries the revert reason; never ask anyone to sign a failing build. A swap-route failure can be retried by rebuilding with `forceSwapper: true` (build_open, build_adjust push, build_repay auto, build_close). `share` defaults to 'failure-only', so a passing simulation never publishes the owner's calldata as a public link.

from.description: Owner EOA that will sign the steps
